## 题目内容

33. The shared goal of GDA’s projects to         .
A. explore new cultures
B. protect the environment
C. gain corporate benefit
D. help communities in need

## 选项

A. A. explore new cultures

B. B. protect the environment

C. C. gain corporate benefit

D. D. help communities in need

---

## 参考答案

D
